content: Aime maa monic sugucnehac sawawa yanguc fikewec. Ngigac monic ngiyewec, ye wenacti ngakpi ingucne aicnowec. Nga higeinele bagewa tamacne ngiyewec. Aime hodocina asocmeng 12 yengi ngictaule duu ingucne ngiyeibong.
Ye gobeholec, aime kogoc fikenale gado hime aukwewec.
Aime maa monic sawawa fikewec. Hei, hematowa sasacne ingucne monic sugucnebenang ngiyewec. Ye hodocine 7 nga begicine 10. Ailu ye hodocina ngictaule duu 7 holelu ngiyewec.

Ngiyelu ye gicinedi sawawale asocmeng habu sugucne yogowacni habackang heuckelu iwacni nebocine pelengkelu himongka wicebawec. Aime ngigac yogo kogoc banale aime hematowa ye kogoc yogo gbokenale ngagelu ngigac yele haicka domawec.

Domame ngigac ye madec monic bawec. Bame yele gboli yogo biyacbenang Wapongta balu feibong. Bafelu yele ngictaule ngiye-ngiyewa lobong fawec. Aime madec yogo, ye himongne himongne ngic-ngigac aen yasudi damongebadaicte.

Aime ngigac ye himong kisiwa misaine mikacka hangoc hikewec. Hikeme yengi ye hadeng 1 taosen 260le kwelina noba-nosing lacnolu ngani-damong aicnodaingte. Wapongti yele mac ngiye-ngiye iwa biyachac bamockewec.
Aime honocmengka hudu sugucne fikewec. Iwa yanguc fikewec, Maikel nga angelofocine yenge hematowa yeholec wenagulu hematowa nga angelofocine yenge hudu ameine bafaliyeibong.
Ailu tapilingineng mikac aime yengi hatacmac honocmengka gagale sawaine monic mi fawec.

Aime hematowa ye hema esecne, yele wac monic Aleng Sugucnengineng nga Satang, ye nga angelofocine wicebabong himongka waibong. Yedi himongtowawa ngic-ngigac sasawa kwesacka mengocebame yenge ye balaibecaigaing.
Aime yowa-malac sugucne monic honocmengka yanguc mime ngageiba,

content.text: “Wasecne ainogale dameng nga tapili ailu ngani-damong yogolec fileine Wapong, yogo yakumac noine fikegac.
Aime Kristo bawosaewec, yedi yakumac yogolec bole-yowa tapiliineholec balu gagac.
Ngic hae-gbafocnonggeng yowawa locebacaigac, yedi Wapongnonggengte haicka deboc hadeng yowawa locebalu game ye biyachac honocmengkacni wickebong wawec.
Ngic hae-gbafocnonggeng yenge Lama madecinele sac nga Sugucnele yowa mibong yegengkewecte gbelong ailu Aleng Sugucnengineng huduwa ewaliibong.
Ailu yengileng kwelenginengti gaganginengte ngagebong feicne mi aime homacte mi hangocebawec.
Honocmeng nga aling honocmengka gacaigaing, ngenge wiyac honocmengka fikewecte ailu beliyedaing.
Aimebac, mee, himongka nga kiwecka gagaing, ngenge medecngebadaic.
I yangucte, Aleng Sugucnengineng ye ngengela kwesigac.
Ailu damengngine bangkaleme ngagegacte ailu kwele-dackolec aalickegac.”

content: Yenge hematowa himongka wickebong wawec, ye yogo ngani-motolu ngigac kogoc gobeelu madec bawec, ye yebiyewec.

Yebiyeme ngigac ye hemale haickacni hangoc hikelu himong kisiwa misaine mikacka hikenale aime, monicti ngigac yogo hikictowa kwegecine lacnome filalangkelu hikewec. Mac yogo yele mac ngiye-ngiye iwa biyachac bamockewec, yogowa hikewec. Ye iwa hifa 3 nga hifa monic nebocine dameng inguc ngiyeme yengi ye ngani-damong aicnolu nosing lacnodaingte.
Lacnobong hemadi ye yebiyelu lumong ingucne banale micinacni misa mengume misa ingucne walu hikewec.
Hikeme himongti ngigac bafickelu micine angkeme, hematowadi misa micinacni mengume wame, himongti misa yogo gbokewec.

Gbokeme hematowa ye ngigac yele aalic ngagewec. Ngagelu hike ngigac yele adu-madecfocine Wapongte ung-yowa balaibelu gacaigaing, ailu Yesu Kristole siduc yogo mibong yegengkeme balaibecaigaing, yenge hudu sugucnedi wecebanale hikewec.
Ailu ye kiwec mecina dingongka domawec.
